mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments (user_id, course_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM enrollments WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.update: UPDATE enrollments SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND status <> 'COMPLETED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.id AS course_id, c.slug, c.title, c.summary, c.category, c.level, u.display_name AS instructor_name, e.status, e.enrolled_at, e.completed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters ch WHERE ch.course_id = c.id) AS total_chapters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapter_progress p WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id AND p.course_id = c.id) AS completed_chapters, (SELECT ch.id FROM chapters ch WHERE ch.course_id = c.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chapter_progress p WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id AND p.chapter_id = ch.id) ORDER BY ch.position, ch.id LIMIT 1) AS next_chapter_id, a.due_date, ab.display_name AS assigned_by_name FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.id = e.course_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.instructor_id LEFT JOIN assignments a ON a.user_id = e.user_id AND a.course_id = e.course_id LEFT JOIN users ab ON ab.id = a.assigned_by WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.due_date IS NULL, a.due_date, e.enrolled_at DESC
